rationale: Freeze the KAN-275 durable-bookkeeping contract before source work. The nightly sync wrote to a container-local path on Render's ephemeral free-tier filesystem and reported success while its output was discarded (same silent-success class as KAN-273). The store keeps bookkeeping only (idempotency key, lease with fencing token, heartbeat, last-success); the corpus is derived from Google Drive and is rebuildable.
